candidates.name: per-logical-asset-bytes-copy
reasons: 相同 bytes 產生兩個不可由 checksum 收斂的 physical copies；不符合 duplicate bytes 可解釋性。

candidates.name: revision-direct-local-file-path
reasons: revision 只保存 path，沒有 central registry；archive 後無法在 mutation 前證明 reference 或阻止 dangling path。

contract.logical_assets: assets separately identify authoring records and availability
contract.physical_bytes: checksum-addressed object; identical bytes stored once
contract.reconciliation: temp/DB intent faults reconcile to no orphan bytes or dangling metadata
contract.references: unique revision-reference registry points only to logical assets
contract.restore: archived referenced media blocks revision restore until asset is restored
